van los campos de texto, indexados por el `id` del proyecto. Lo que no esté

perfil.titulo: Double Degree in Computer Engineering and Business Administration - University of Granada

ciber-asesoria.tituloSeo: Ciber-AsesorIA: ENS, NIS2 and DORA compliance
ciber-asesoria.resumen: Bachelor's thesis: an engine that, given a company profile and a legislative control, deterministically infers which technical requirements ENS, NIS2 and DORA impose on it, and runs a conversational audit that issues a traceable, scored verdict.
ciber-asesoria.descripcionSeo: Bachelor's thesis: an engine that deterministically infers what ENS, NIS2 and DORA require of a company and runs an audit with a traceable verdict.
destacados: Principle of Maxima resolved in Cypher over Neo4j: for each control it selects the strictest requirement across the three frameworks, combining floors, reinforcements and exclusions
Deterministic inference by graph query, kept apart from the LLM stages: the verdict can be reconstructed and explained
Anti-false-positive LLM judge that filters the candidates coming out of the semantic search, degrading in a controlled way to the top 3 by similarity if the model fails
Conversational agent that turns each requirement into business language and audits it one requirement at a time
Deterministic 1–10 score, verdict cache shared between controls and a per-session audit trail
CITAD module to classify the organisation's ENS category

Validation by invariants derived from the regulatory specifications, not from the engine's own output: 346 checks (33 unit tests, 142 from the NIS2 PCE, 135 from DORA, 36 on dimensional weighting) plus 1,572 cross-mode comparisons, all satisfied
The test batteries uncovered real defects in the scope of the NIS2 exclusions and in the ENS–DORA crosswalk, and made it possible to fix them
Analysis of how it fits the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689): transparency-obligation tier, with determinism, traceability and a human in the loop
All 9 specific objectives met
ciber-asesoria.contexto: Bachelor's thesis - Double Degree in Computer Engineering and Business Administration, University of Granada. Supervisor: Dr. Pedro García Teodoro
ciber-asesoria.autoria: Ciber-AsesorIA is a joint project made of two subsystems. My thesis is the ST module (inference engine, assessment agent, CITAD and the integration with the Coordinator), plus the CITAD and Autopilot pieces of the frontend. The SN module and the rest of the frontend are the work of my project partner, Laura.

habla-con-tu-dinero.titulo: Habla con tu dinero - Conversational banking assistant
habla-con-tu-dinero.tituloSeo: Habla con tu dinero: AI banking assistant
habla-con-tu-dinero.resumen: An assistant that lets you handle your finances by voice or in writing: check your balance, send a Bizum (the Spanish instant transfer system), analyse transactions in plain language and produce charts that the model itself designs.
habla-con-tu-dinero.descripcionSeo: Banking assistant by voice or in writing: check your balance, send a Bizum transfer, analyse transactions in plain language and produce charts with AI.
destacados: LLM agent with tool calling: four tools orchestrated by the model over a simulated banking API
NL → SQL with server-side validation: read-only, a single statement and a keyword blacklist
Charts without templates: the LLM decides the visualisation and emits the full Chart.js configuration
Two-way voice: Whisper large-v3-turbo for input and Piper (a local neural voice) as the output fallback
Three-provider fallback chain that switches over mid-message on a 429, at around 3 s per turn
History compaction that cuts roughly 90% of the tokens per request
Token-by-token SSE streaming
Accessible by design: it works entirely in writing

museo-ar.titulo: Museo AR - Augmented reality museum guide
museo-ar.resumen: An AR application that detects ArUco markers through a webcam and overlays 3D models of historical pieces, with face recognition of the visitor, spoken queries and photo souvenirs sent by email.
destacados: Detection of ArUco DICT_5X5_50 markers and rendering of glTF models aligned with the real world
Face recognition for persistent visitor registration across sessions
Voice interaction: spoken questions about the pieces on display
Automatic generation and delivery of photo souvenirs over SMTP
Context awareness: themed zones identified by image or marker
museo-ar.contexto: Ubiquitous Computing and Ambient Intelligence - University of Granada

tienda-online.resumen: A complete e-commerce site with an Express + MongoDB backend, an authenticated REST API, a React frontend and a containerised deployment with Caddy as the reverse proxy.
destacados: REST API with separate routes for the shop, the users and the public API
Authentication and user session management
Type-ahead search (autocomplete) and shopping cart
React + Vite + Tailwind frontend with reusable components
Deployment with Docker Compose and a separate production configuration
Centralised logging and a reproducible database seed
tienda-online.contexto: Internet Application Development - University of Granada

waf-modsecurity.titulo: WAF with ModSecurity and the OWASP CRS on Docker
waf-modsecurity.resumen: A Web Application Firewall sitting between the client and a farm of web servers, with OWASP CRS rules and a measurement of what it costs in performance.
destacados: Nginx + ModSecurity v3 + OWASP Core Rule Set in a dedicated container
Mitigation of SQLi, XSS and LFI/RFI verified through functional tests
A 1 WAF + 2 Apache backends architecture on an internal Docker network
Custom rule exclusions for WebSocket/Socket.IO traffic
Cost measured with Apache Benchmark: 2,586 → 1,663 req/s and +2.1 ms per request, without a single failed request
CRS rules that fire: 942100/942110 (SQLi through libinjection), 941100/941110/941160/941320 (XSS), 930100/930120 (path traversal), 932160 (remote execution)
waf-modsecurity.contexto: High Performance Web Servers - University of Granada

granja-web.resumen: Design, deployment and evaluation of a scalable web farm: load balancing compared across five technologies, TLS, firewalling and benchmarking.
destacados: Empirical comparison of Nginx, HAProxy, Traefik, Envoy and GoBetween as load balancers
HTTPS with certificates generated and managed through OpenSSL
Perimeter security with iptables at container level
Benchmarking under load with Apache Benchmark and Locust
Reproducible scenarios, deployable with a single command
granja-web.contexto: High Performance Web Servers - University of Granada

agente-ia.titulo: Intelligent agent for a competitive game
agente-ia.resumen: A turn-based agent that picks its moves with Minimax and Alpha-Beta pruning, and evaluation heuristics refined over several iterations.
destacados: Minimax with Alpha-Beta pruning: the same decision as full Minimax at a far lower cost
Greater search depth within the available time limit
Three generations of heuristic: simple counting → positional value → combined with items
Validated in competition against other agents
agente-ia.contexto: Artificial Intelligence - University of Granada (Parcheesi engine with SFML)

motor-grafico.resumen: A 3D graphics application built incrementally: scene graph, cameras, hierarchical animation, lighting and object picking.
destacados: Scene graph with per-node local transformations
Articulated animations driven from the keyboard
Phong lighting with ambient/diffuse/specular materials and textures
Colour picking for interactive selection of sub-parts
Several switchable cameras with orthographic and perspective projection

ecommerce-oracle.resumen: A desktop system connecting buyers and sellers that handles users, products, cart, orders, payments and reviews on top of an Oracle database.
destacados: Five subsystems: users, products, cart, orders and reviews
Automatic transactional stock control when an order is confirmed or cancelled
Sign-up with unique-email validation and password recovery by token
Soft deletion of products and permanent disabling of accounts
Receipt confirmation, either manual or automatic after 3 days
ecommerce-oracle.contexto: Information Systems Design and Development - University of Granada

irrgarten.titulo: Irrgarten - the same game in Java and Ruby
irrgarten.resumen: A turn-based maze game implemented in full in two languages, comparing how each one solves the same object-oriented design.
destacados: Complete domain model: Player, Monster, Labyrinth, Game, Weapon, Shield, Dice
Randomness encapsulated in a single Dice class
Design driven by high cohesion and low coupling
Parallel implementation in Java and Ruby from the same class diagram
irrgarten.contexto: Object-Oriented Programming and Design - University of Granada

agenda-digital.titulo: Agenda Digital - cross-platform app for academic events
agenda-digital.tituloSeo: Agenda Digital: Flutter app with a Rails backend
agenda-digital.resumen: A Flutter application with a Ruby on Rails backend for managing academic events organised in a hierarchical tree of months, weeks, days and events.
destacados: Cross-platform Flutter client (iOS, Android, Web) with Material Design 3
REST API backend in Ruby on Rails 8.1 with ActiveRecord and SQLite
Composite pattern for the Month → Week → Day → Event hierarchy
Factory Method to instantiate the three event types (exam, office hours, other)
Urgent events flagged with a display of their own
agenda-digital.contexto: Software Development - University of Granada (group work)

clasificador-idiomas.titulo: Automatic language classifier based on bigrams
clasificador-idiomas.resumen: A C++ system that models each language by the frequency of its character pairs and classifies an unknown text by measuring its distance to the known models.
destacados: A language model as a bigram profile, serialised to its own .bgr format
Classification by distance between models: it gets Spanish, English, French and German right on real literary texts
Clean separation: the right language lands at about 0.08 distance and the rest above 0.21
Manual dynamic memory management, with no STL containers
A BigramCounter class with matrix counting for efficient tallying
Incremental development over six iterations (Language0 → Language5)
